integrity: A complete analytical proof and exhaustive 65536-configuration checker are included. Same-model review only; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the 16-vertex degree-five folded 5-cube at zero temperature with uniform classical antiferromagnetic exchange. The known zero-field maximum-cut information and basic independent-set counting are not separately claimed as new. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains unverified.
title: Exact three-phase magnetic response of the Clebsch Ising antiferromagnet
